text_block_list.text:
One day, I arrive at the training track to
find it
much more crowded than usual.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Well... we sure do have a lot of guests
today.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine. I'm used to this kind of
clamor from
my races, anyway.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: That said, it is much easier for me to focus when it's quiet.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
We continue with our training, but I
can't help but
notice that Grass
Wonder's running seems a bit
lackluster
that day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
